summary: End-to-end testing of Ghar Banwao home page: backend APIs (calculator config, projects, leads) and frontend flows (hero calculator, full calculator section, projects map, search overlay, consultation form, share-estimate flow, all 19 sections, /calculator route, mobile sticky bar). 14/14 backend pytest cases pass. All critical frontend flows pass with no console errors.

integration_issues.issue: search-overlay DOM element remains with count=1 after Escape and before pressing '/'. Could not confirm visible open/close toggle via count alone. If the overlay element is kept mounted with hidden state this is acceptable, but worth confirming visibility is toggled.

action_items: LOW: Verify SearchOverlay visually closes on Escape (DOM count stayed at 1 after Escape; functional slash reopen also returned 1 — likely AnimatePresence keeping node, no functional bug observed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: good use of _id projection, Pydantic validation, uuid ids. Seed is idempotent on empty collection.

Area->SQM conversion for 2000 sqm→21,528 sqft is correct (1 sqm = 10.7639 sqft). Spec sample total ₹33,02,000 for area=2000 was approximate; actual engine gives ₹32,76,046 for 2000 sqft Lucknow — within expected tolerance (<1%).
Consider adding a basic phone format validator (10 digit) at Pydantic layer to reject obviously-invalid phone numbers.
seed_data_creation: Created test leads: TEST_Rahul (consultation_form), TEST_Priya (share_estimate), TEST_ConsultUser (consultation_form via UI), TEST_ShareUser (share_estimate via UI).

For frontend: use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and wait_until='domcontentloaded' (networkidle sometimes times out due to analytics/font requests). Shadcn/radix selects: click trigger then wait 200ms before clicking option. For hero city dropdown use data-testid='hero-city-option-noida'.
